title: Negotiating Control and Accountability among Stakeholders in High-Risk AI Use Cases: Development and Evaluation of the Method ALIGN
abstract: arXiv:2611.24609v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Characteristics of Artificial Intelligence (AI) severely restrict human control. This creates new challenges for socio-technical systems design especially in safety-critical domains, where control over risks is essential along with the accountability for any harm caused. Drawing from human factors and AI governance literature, expert interviews and participant observation in a complex high-risk AI use case from the railways, we developed ALIGN, a scenario-based method that supports the governance of and stakeholder involvement in AI development and implementation in three ways: raising awareness for potential accountability-control misalignments in socio-technical systems and their negative consequences, offering a structured approach to assessing the alignment between accountability and control for stakeholders in a given use case, and supporting effective design decisions to mitigate AI risks. translated_title: 在高风险AI应用场景中协商利益相关者之间的控制权与问责制：ALIGN方法的开发与评估
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）的特性严重限制了人类的控制能力。这为社会技术系统设计带来了新的挑战，尤其是在安全攸关的领域——在这些领域中，对风险的控制以及针对任何已造成损害的问责都至关重要。基于人因工程与AI治理领域的文献、专家访谈，以及在铁路领域一个复杂的高风险AI应用案例中开展的参与式观察，我们开发了ALIGN——一种基于情景的方法，它通过三种方式支持AI开发与实施中的治理及利益相关者参与：提高人们对社会技术系统中潜在的“问责-控制”错位及其负面后果的认识；提供一种结构化的方法，用于评估特定应用场景中利益相关者的问责与控制之间的对齐程度；并支持有效的设计决策以减轻AI风险。我们描述了迭代的开发过程……
tldr: 本文开发了ALIGN这一基于情景的方法，用以识别高风险AI应用中问责与控制之间的错位，支持利益相关者参与AI治理并做出降低AI风险的设计决策。
en_tdlr: This paper develops ALIGN, a scenario-based method that raises awareness of accountability-control misalignments, provides a structured approach to assessing alignment among stakeholders, and supports design decisions to mitigate AI risks in high-risk AI use cases.
